name: Conditioning-Minimal Non-Ample Classes Are Not Conditioning-Closed
statement: Every nonempty one-coordinate conditioning is a maximum class of VC dimension $k-1$ on $n-1$ coordinates, and every nonempty proper iterated conditioning belongs to UOMFib. Thus every proper conditioning is ample and lies outside the conditioning-minimal non-ample class.
proof: One-coordinate conditionings are ample by definition; uniformity gives their exact cardinality and forces equality in Sauer's bound. Iterated conditionings are exactly nonempty topal fibers of the uniform-oriented-matroid parent, with the parallel rank-one cases reducing to singleton cubes.
